scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @loan-console/calculation && npm run build --workspace @loan-console/shared && npm run build --workspace @loan-console/validation
scripts.build:server: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @loan-console/api
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k "npm run dev --workspace @loan-console/api" "npm run dev --workspace @loan-console/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @loan-console/api && npm run build --workspace @loan-console/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @loan-console/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @loan-console/web
scripts.admin:create: npm run build:server && node apps/api/dist/cli/admin.js create
scripts.admin:reset-password: npm run build:server && node apps/api/dist/cli/admin.js reset-password
